Then God the Almighty said: Whoever is an enemy to God and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, God is an enemy to the disbelievers 3:17. God the Almighty says: Whoever is an enemy to Me and My angels and My messengers, and His messengers include His messengers from the angels and from the humans, as God the Almighty said: God chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. “Gabriel and Michael” This is a case of connecting the specific to the general, as they were included among the angels in the generality of the messengers, then they were specifically mentioned because the context is in support of Gabriel, who is the ambassador between God and His prophets, and Michael was paired with him in the wording, because the Jews claimed that Gabriel was their enemy, and Michael was their friend, so God Almighty informed them that whoever is hostile to one of them has been hostile to the other and hostile to God as well, and because he also descends to the prophets of God sometimes, as he was paired with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, at the beginning, but Gabriel is more and it is his job, and Michael is entrusted with plants and rain, this one with guidance and this one with provision, just as Israfil is entrusted with blowing the trumpet for the resurrection on the Day of Resurrection, and for this reason it came in the Sahih that “when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, got up at night he would say: O God, Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants in that in which they differ, guide me to the truth in that in which they differ by Your permission, for You guide whomever You will.” To the straight path.” Al-Bukhari has already narrated, and Ibn Jarir narrated on the authority of Ikrimah and others that he said, Jabr, Mika, and Israf are slaves, and Il is God. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ahmad bin Sinan told us, Abd al-Rahman bin Mahdi told us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of al-A’mash, on the authority of Ismail bin Abi Raja’, on the authority of Umair, the freed slave of Ibn Abbas, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: His saying Gabriel was like his saying Abdullah and Abd al-Rahman. It was said that Jabr is a slave, and Il is God. Muhammad bin Ishaq said on the authority of al-Zuhri, on the authority of Ali bin al-Husayn, who said: Do you know what Gabriel’s name is among your names? We said: No. He said: His name is Abdullah, and every name that goes back to Il is to God, the Almighty and Majestic. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Something similar was narrated on the authority of Ikrimah, Mujahid, al-Dahhak, and Yahya bin Ya’mar. Then he said: My father told me, Ahmad bin Abi Al-Hawari told us, Abdul Aziz bin Umair told me: The name Gabriel among the angels is the servant of God. He said: So I told it to Abu Sulayman Al-Darani, and he was shaken and said: This hadith is dearer to me than anything in a notebook that was in his hands. And Gabriel and Michael have dialects and readings that are mentioned in the books of language and readings, and we did not prolong this book of ours by listing that unless the understanding of the meaning revolves around it, or the judgment in that goes back to it, and in God is trust and He is the one sought for help. And the Almighty’s saying: Then God is an enemy to the disbelievers in it is the placement of the explicit in place of the implicit where He did not say: then he is an enemy, but rather He said: Then God is an enemy to the disbelievers as the poet said: I do not see death preceded by anything that made death bitter to the rich and the poor The other said: If only the crow would caw constantly tomorrow, it would be a crow with severed jugular veins. God has only revealed this name here to establish and make clear this meaning, and to inform them that whoever is hostile to a friend of God has been hostile to God, and whoever is hostile to God, then God is his enemy, and whoever is his enemy has lost this world and the hereafter, as the hadith has mentioned: Whoever is hostile to a friend of Mine, then I have declared war on him. And in another hadith: I will take revenge for My friends as a lion takes revenge for war. And in the authentic hadith: Whoever I am an opponent of, I will be his opponent.
2:98: Imam Abu Ja`far ibn Jarir al-Tabari, may God have mercy on him, said: All scholars of interpretation agreed that this verse was revealed in response to the Jews of the Children of Israel, when they claimed that Gabriel was their enemy and that Michael was their guardian. Then they differed about the reason for which they said that. Some of them said: The reason for their saying that was because of a debate that took place between them and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, regarding the matter of his prophethood mentioning who said that. Abu Kurayb told us, Yunus ibn Bakir told us, on the authority of `Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram, on the authority of Shahr ibn Hawshab, on the authority of Ibn `Abbas, who said: A group of Jews attended the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they said: O Abu al-Qasim, tell us about characteristics that we ask you about that only a prophet would know. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Ask about whatever you wish, but give me God’s protection and what Jacob took from his sons, that if I tell you about something and you recognize it, you will follow me in Islam. They said: That is for you. He said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Ask about whatever you wish. They said: Tell us about four things that we will ask you about. Tell us which food Israel prohibited for himself before the Torah was revealed? And tell us about the woman’s water and the man’s water, and how the male and female are formed from it? And tell us about this unlettered prophet in the Torah, and who is his guardian from the angels? The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: You have a covenant from God that if I inform you, you will all follow me. So they gave him whatever covenant and pact God willed. He said: I ask you by the One who sent down the Torah to Moses, do you know that Israel Jacob fell seriously ill and his illness lasted a long time? He made a vow to God that if God cured him of his illness, he would forbid him the food and drink he loved the most. The food he loved the most was camel meat, and the drink he loved the most was camel milk. They said: O God, yes. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: O God, bear witness against them. I ask you by God, there is no god but Him, who sent down the Torah to Moses, do you know that the man’s semen is thick and white, and the woman’s semen is thin and yellow, so whichever of them rises above will have a child and will resemble him, by God’s permission? If the man’s semen rises above the woman’s semen, the child will be a boy, by God’s permission. If the woman’s semen rises above the man’s semen, the child will be a girl, by God’s permission. They said: O God, yes. He said: O God, bear witness. I ask you by God, who sent down the Torah to Moses, do you know that the eyes of this illiterate prophet sleep but his heart does not? They said: Yes, by God. He said: O God, bear witness. They said: You now, so tell us who is your guardian from the angels, then we will have intercourse with you or leave you. He said: My guardian is Gabriel, and God never sent a prophet except that he is his guardian. They said: Then we will leave you, and if your guardian were other than him from the angels, we would follow you and believe you. He said: What prevents you from believing him? They said: He is our enemy. So God the Almighty revealed: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - indeed, he has brought it down upon your heart by God’s permission, confirming what was before it” to His saying: If they only knew. Then they incurred wrath upon wrath.” Imam Ahmad narrated it in his Musnad on the authority of Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim and Abd al-Rahman ibn Hamid in his Tafsir on the authority of Ahmad ibn Yunus, both of them on the authority of Abd al-Hamid ibn Bahram, and Ahmad also narrated it on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Marwazi on the authority of Abd al-Hamid in a similar manner. Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Yasar narrated it, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Husayn told us, on the authority of Shahr ibn Hawshab, and he mentioned it as a mursal and added to it: “They said: Then tell us about the spirit.” He said: I ask you by God and by His days with the Children of Israel, do you know that he is Gabriel and he is the one who comes to me? They said: O God, yes, but he is an enemy to us, and he is an angel who only comes with hardship and bloodshed. If it were not for that, we would have followed you. So God the Almighty revealed about them: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel” to His saying: They do not know. And he said: Imam Ahmad: Abu Ahmad told us, Abdullah bin Al-Waleed Al-Ajli told us, on the authority of Bakir bin Shihab, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Jews came to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: O Abu Al-Qasim, tell us about five things, for if you inform us of them, we will know that you are a prophet and we will follow you. So he took from them what Israel took from his sons, when he said: God is the witness over what we say. He said: Bring them. They said: So tell us about the sign of a prophet? He said: His eyes sleep but his heart does not sleep. They said: Tell us how a woman is made feminine? And how a man is made masculine? He said: The two waters meet, so if the man’s water rises above the woman’s water, she becomes masculine, and if the woman’s water rises above the man’s water, she becomes feminine. They said: Tell us what Israel forbade himself? He said: He used to suffer from sciatica, and he did not find anything that suited him except the milk of such-and-such. Ahmad said: Some of them said: He meant camels, so he forbade their meat. They said: You have spoken the truth. They said: Tell us, what is this thunder? He said: An angel from the angels of God Almighty, who is assigned to the clouds, with his hands or in his hands is a whip of fire with which he drives the clouds where God Almighty commands him. They said: What is this voice that we hear? He said: His voice. They said: You have spoken the truth. They said: There is only one thing left, and it is the one that we will follow if you tell us about it, that there is no prophet but that he has an angel who brings him report, so tell us who your companion is? He said: Gabriel, peace be upon him. They said: Gabriel is the one who descends with war, fighting and torment. He is our enemy. If you had said Michael, who descends with mercy, rain and plants, he would have been. So God Almighty revealed: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - for he has brought it down upon your heart by permission of God” to the end of the verse. Al-Tirmidhi and Al-Nasa’i narrated it from the hadith of Abdullah bin Al-Waleed with it. Al-Tirmidhi said: Hasan Gharib. Sunayd said in his interpretation on the authority of Hajjaj bin Muhammad on the authority of Ibn Jurayj: Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazza informed me that the Jews asked the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, about his companion who descends with revelation. He said: Gabriel. They said: He is our enemy and does not come except with war, hardship and fighting. So the verse was revealed: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel” 2:10. Ibn Jarir said: Mujahid said: The Jews said: O Muhammad, Gabriel only descends with hardship, war and fighting. He is our enemy. So the verse was revealed: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel” 2:10. Al-Bukhari said: God Almighty’s statement: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel 2:10. Ikrimah said: Gabriel, Mika and Israf are slaves. Il: God, Abdullah bin Munir told us, Abdullah bin Bakr heard, Humaid told us, on the authority of Anas bin Malik, he said: Abdullah bin Salam heard of the arrival of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, while he was in a land collecting dung, so he came to the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: I am going to ask you about three things that only a prophet knows: What is the first sign of the Hour, what is the first food of the people of Paradise, and what will draw a father to his father or to his mother? He said: Gabriel told me this just now. He said: Gabriel? He said: Yes. He said: That is the enemy of the Jews from the angels, so he recited this verse: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - indeed, he has brought it down upon your heart. “As for the first sign of the Hour, it is a fire that will gather people from the east to the west. As for the first food that the people of Paradise will eat, it is the extra liver of a fish. If a man’s semen precedes a woman’s semen, the child will be conceived, and if a woman’s semen precedes a woman, she will be conceived.” He said: I bear witness that there is no god but God and that you are the Messenger of God. O Messenger of God, the Jews are a people of slanderers, and if they know that I have become Muslim before you ask them, they will slander me. So the Jews came and the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to him: What kind of man is Abdullah bin Salam among you? They said: The best of us and the son of the best of us, our master and the son of our master. He said: What if he becomes Muslim? They said: May God protect him from that. So Abdullah came out and said: I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God. They said: He is our evil and the son of our evil, and they attacked him. He said: This is what I feared, O Messenger of God. Al-Bukhari alone narrated it from this source, and they narrated it from another source from Anas in a similar manner. In Sahih Muslim, from Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, it is close to this context, as will come in its place, God willing. Al-Bukhari’s narration, as mentioned above, from Ikrimah is the well-known one that El is God. Sufyan al-Thawri narrated it from Khasif, from Ikrimah, and Abd ibn Humayd narrated it from Ibrahim ibn al-Hakam, from his father, from Ikrimah, and Ibn Jarir narrated it from al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Tahan, from Ishaq ibn Mansur, from Qays ibn Asim, from Ikrimah, that he said: Gabriel’s name is Abdullah, and Michael’s name is Abdullah. El is God. Yazid al-Nahwi narrated it from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, in the same manner. More than one of the Salaf said the same, as will come soon. Some people say: El is an expression for Abd, and the other word is the name of God, because the word El does not change in all of them. Fawzan is Abdullah Abd al-Rahman Abd al-Malik. Abdul Quddus Abdul Salam Abdul Kafi Abdul Jalil, so Abdul is present in all of this, and the names added to it differ, as well as Gabriel, Michael, Azrael, Israfil, and the like, and in the speech of non-Arabs they put the added to it before the added, and God knows best. Then Ibn Jarir said, and others said: Rather, the reason for their saying that was because of a debate that took place between them and Umar ibn al-Khattab regarding the matter of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace mention those who said that. Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna told me, Rib’i ibn Ulayyah told me, on the authority of Dawud ibn Abi Hind, on the authority of al-Sha’bi, who said: Umar went down to al-Rawha’ and saw men rushing to stones to pray to them, so he said: What is wrong with these people? They said: They claim that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, prayed here. He said: He disliked that and said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was overtaken by prayer in a valley and prayed there, then he departed and left it, then he began to tell them, and he said: I used to witness the Jews during their schools and I was amazed at how the Torah confirmed the Qur’an and how the Qur’an confirmed the Torah. While I was with them one day, they said: O Ibn al-Khattab, none of your companions are more beloved to us than you. I said: Why is that? They said: Because you visit us and come to us. I said: I come to you and I am amazed at the Qur’an and how it confirms the Torah, and at the Torah and how it confirms the Qur’an. They said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, passed by and they said: O Ibn Al-Khattab, that is your companion, so join him. I said to them: At that time, I ask you by God, there is no god but Him, and by what He has entrusted to you of His right, and by what He has entrusted to you of His Book, do you know that he is the Messenger of God? They said: So they were silent. Then their scholar and elder said to him: He has been harsh with you, so answer him. They said: Then you are our scholar and elder, so answer him. He said: If you ask us what you ask us, then we know that he is the Messenger of God. I said: Woe to you, then you are doomed. They said: We are not doomed. I said: How is that when you know that he is the Messenger of God and you do not follow him or believe him? They said: We have an enemy from the angels and a peace from the angels, and he has linked his prophethood to our enemy from the angels. I said: Who is your enemy and your peace? They said: Our enemy is Gabriel, and our peace is Michael. They said: Gabriel is the angel of harshness, roughness, poverty, severity, torment, and the like, and Michael is the angel of mercy, compassion, leniency, and the like. He said: I said: What is their status with their Lord, the Almighty and Majestic? They said: One of them is on his right and the other is on his left. He said: I said: By Him besides Whom there is no god, they and the one between them are enemies to those who are enemies to them, and peace to those who are peaceable to them. It is not appropriate for Gabriel to be peaceable to the enemy of Michael, and it is not appropriate for Michael to be peaceable to the enemy of Gabriel. He said: Then I got up and followed the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and I caught up with him as he was coming out of a window of the Banu so-and-so. He said: O Ibn al-Khattab, shall I not recite to you verses that were revealed before? So he recited to me: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - indeed, he has brought it down to your heart by permission of God - until he recited the verses. He said: I said: My father and mother are your ransom, O Messenger of God, by Him who sent you with the truth, I have come wanting to inform you and I hear the Gracious, the All-Knowing, who has preceded me to you with the report. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Saeed al-Ashja told us, Abu Usama told us on the authority of Mujalid, Aamer told us, he said: Umar ibn al-Khattab went to the Jews and said: I ask you by Him who revealed the Torah to Moses, do you find Muhammad in your books? They said: Yes. He said: What prevents you from following him? He said: God did not send a messenger except that He made for him a guardian from the angels. Gabriel is the guardian of Muhammad and he is the one who comes to him, and he is our enemy from the angels. And Michael, we have submitted. If Michael was the one who came to him, we would have submitted. He said: Then I ask you by God who sent down the Torah to Moses, what is their status with God Almighty? They said: Gabriel is on his right, and Michael is on his left. Omar said: I bear witness that they do not descend except by the permission of God. Michael would not make peace with the enemy of Gabriel, and Gabriel would not make peace with the enemy of Michael. While he was with them, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, passed by. They said: This is your companion, O Ibn Al-Khattab. Omar went to him and God, the Almighty, had revealed: Whoever is an enemy to God and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, God is an enemy to the disbelievers. These two chains of transmission indicate that Al-Sha’bi narrated it from Omar, but there is a break between him and Omar, as he did not live in his time. And God knows best. Ibn Jubayr said: Bashir told us, Yazid bin Zari’ told us, on the authority of Sa’id, on the authority of Qatadah, who said: It was mentioned to us that Omar bin Al-Khattab went to the Jews one day. When he returned and they welcomed him, Omar said to them: By God, I did not come to you out of love for you or desire for you, but I came to hear from you. So he asked them and they asked him, and they said: Who is the companion of your companion? He said to them: Gabriel. They said: That is our enemy from the people of heaven who reveals our secret to Muhammad, and when he comes he brings war and strife, but the companion of our companion is Michael, and when he comes he brings fertility and peace. So Omar said to them: Do you recognize Gabriel, and you deny Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace? Then Omar left them and went towards the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, to tell him their story, and he found that this verse had been revealed to him: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - for he has brought the Qur’an down upon your heart by God’s permission” (al-An’am 2:10). Then he said: Al-Muthanna told me, Adam told us, Abu Ja`far told us, Qatada told us, he said: It reached us that `Umar came to the Jews one day and mentioned something similar, and this is in the interpretation of Adam and it is also disconnected, and likewise Asbat narrated it from Al-Suddi from `Umar something similar or similar, and it is also disconnected. And Ibn Ibn Hatim said: Muhammad Ibn `Ammar told us, `Abd Al-Rahman told us, meaning Al-Dashtaki told us, Abu Ja`far told us from Hisayn Ibn `Abd Al-Rahman, from `Abd Al-Rahman, who is `Abd Al-Rahman Ibn Abi Laila: That a Jew met `Umar Ibn Al-Khattab and said: Gabriel, whom your companion mentions, is an enemy to us, so `Umar said: Whoever is an enemy to God and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael, then indeed God is an enemy to the disbelievers. He said: So it was revealed on the tongue of `Umar, may God be pleased with him, and `Abd Ibn Hamid narrated it from Abu Al-Nadr Hashim Ibn Al-Qasim, from Abu Ja`far, who is Al-Razi, and Ibn Jarir said: Ya`qub Ibn Ibrahim told me, Hisham told me, Husayn Ibn `Abd Al-Rahman told us, from Ibn Abi Laila regarding his statement: God the Almighty said: Who is an enemy to Gabriel? He said: The Jews said to the Muslims: If Michael was the one who descends upon you, we would follow you, for he descends with mercy and rain, but Gabriel descends with torment and vengeance, so he is an enemy to us. He said: So this verse was revealed. Yaqub told us, Hisham told us, Abdul Malik told us on the authority of Ata’ something similar. Abdul Razzaq said: Muammar told us on the authority of Qatadah regarding His statement: “Say: Who is an enemy to Gabriel?” He said: The Jews said: Gabriel is an enemy to us, because he descends with hardship and famine, and Michael descends with ease, health and fertility, so Gabriel is an enemy to us. So God the Almighty said: Who is an enemy to Gabriel? As for the interpretation of the verse, the Almighty said: “Say: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel,” then he brought it down to your heart by the permission of God, meaning whoever is hostile to Gabriel, let him know that he is the trustworthy spirit who brought down the wise remembrance to your heart from God by His permission for him to do so. He is a messenger from the messengers of God, an angel. Whoever is hostile to a messenger has been hostile to all the messengers, just as whoever believes in a messenger is obligated to believe in all the messengers, and just as whoever disbelieves in a messenger is obligated to disbelieve in all the messengers, as God the Almighty said: Indeed, those who disbelieve in God and His messengers and wish to differentiate between God and His messengers and say, ‘We believe in some and disbelieve in others,’ 2:100. So He ruled that they are true disbelievers if they believe in some of the messengers and disbelieve in others. Likewise, whoever is hostile to Gabriel is an enemy of God, because Gabriel does not bring down the command of his own accord, but rather he comes down by the command of his Lord, as He said: And We do not descend except by the command of your Lord, 2:100. And God the Almighty said: “And indeed, it is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds. * The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down * Upon your heart that you may be among the warners.” Al-Bukhari narrated in It is authentically reported on the authority of Abu Hurairah, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Whoever shows enmity to a friend of Mine has declared war on Me. For this reason, God became angry with Gabriel for whoever showed enmity to him, and God the Almighty said: Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - indeed, he has brought it down upon your heart by God’s permission, confirming what was before it meaning of the previous books: And guidance and good tidings for the believers meaning guidance for their hearts and good tidings for them of Paradise, and that is only for the believers, as God the Almighty said: Say, ‘It is, for those who believe, a guide and a cure’ 3:17. And God the Almighty said: And We send down from the Qur’an that which is a healing and a mercy for the believers 3:17. Then God the Almighty said: Whoever is an enemy to God and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, God is an enemy to the disbelievers 3:17. God the Almighty says: Whoever is an enemy to Me and My angels and My messengers, and His messengers include His messengers from the angels and from the humans, as God the Almighty said: God chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. “Gabriel and Michael” This is a case of connecting the specific to the general, as they were included among the angels in the generality of the messengers, then they were specifically mentioned because the context is in support of Gabriel, who is the ambassador between God and His prophets, and Michael was paired with him in the wording, because the Jews claimed that Gabriel was their enemy, and Michael was their friend, so God Almighty informed them that whoever is hostile to one of them has been hostile to the other and hostile to God as well, and because he also descends to the prophets of God sometimes, as he was paired with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, at the beginning, but Gabriel is more and it is his job, and Michael is entrusted with plants and rain, this one with guidance and this one with provision, just as Israfil is entrusted with blowing the trumpet for the resurrection on the Day of Resurrection, and for this reason it came in the Sahih that “when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, got up at night he would say: O God, Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, You judge between Your servants in that in which they differ, guide me to the truth in that in which they differ by Your permission, for You guide whomever You will.” To the straight path.” Al-Bukhari has already narrated, and Ibn Jarir narrated on the authority of Ikrimah and others that he said, Jabr, Mika, and Israf are slaves, and Il is God. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ahmad bin Sinan told us, Abd al-Rahman bin Mahdi told us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of al-A’mash, on the authority of Ismail bin Abi Raja’, on the authority of Umair, the freed slave of Ibn Abbas, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: His saying Gabriel was like his saying Abdullah and Abd al-Rahman. It was said that Jabr is a slave, and Il is God. Muhammad bin Ishaq said on the authority of al-Zuhri, on the authority of Ali bin al-Husayn, who said: Do you know what Gabriel’s name is among your names? We said: No. He said: His name is Abdullah, and every name that goes back to Il is to God, the Almighty and Majestic. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Something similar was narrated on the authority of Ikrimah, Mujahid, al-Dahhak, and Yahya bin Ya’mar. Then he said: My father told me, Ahmad bin Abi Al-Hawari told us, Abdul Aziz bin Umair told me: The name Gabriel among the angels is the servant of God. He said: So I told it to Abu Sulayman Al-Darani, and he was shaken and said: This hadith is dearer to me than anything in a notebook that was in his hands. And Gabriel and Michael have dialects and readings that are mentioned in the books of language and readings, and we did not prolong this book of ours by listing that unless the understanding of the meaning revolves around it, or the judgment in that goes back to it, and in God is trust and He is the one sought for help. And the Almighty’s saying: Then God is an enemy to the disbelievers in it is the placement of the explicit in place of the implicit where He did not say: then he is an enemy, but rather He said: Then God is an enemy to the disbelievers as the poet said: I do not see death preceded by anything that made death bitter to the rich and the poor The other said: If only the crow would caw constantly tomorrow, it would be a crow with severed jugular veins. God has only revealed this name here to establish and make clear this meaning, and to inform them that whoever is hostile to a friend of God has been hostile to God, and whoever is hostile to God, then God is his enemy, and whoever is his enemy has lost this world and the hereafter, as the hadith has mentioned: Whoever is hostile to a friend of Mine, then I have declared war on him. And in another hadith: I will take revenge for My friends as a lion takes revenge for war. And in the authentic hadith: Whoever I am an opponent of, I will be his opponent.
2:99: Indeed, We have sent down to you clear verses, and none disbelieve in them except the defiantly disobedient. * Or whenever they make a covenant, a party of them casts it aside? Rather, most of them do not believe. * And when there came to them a messenger from God confirming what was with them, a party of those who were given the Scripture cast the Scripture of God behind their backs as if they did not know. * And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. And Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and what was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. Imam Abu Ja`far ibn Jarir said about the words of God the Almighty: And We have sent down to you clear verses the verse, meaning, We have sent down to you, O Muhammad, clear signs, indicating your prophethood, and those verses are what the Book of God contains of the hidden knowledge of the Jews, and the hidden secrets of their report and the report of their forefathers from the Children of Israel, and the report of what their books contained that only their rabbis and scholars knew, and what their forefathers and later ones distorted and changed of their rulings that It was in the Torah, so God revealed in His Book that He sent down to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and in that were clear signs for those who were fair to themselves and did not let envy and oppression lead to their destruction, since it was in the nature of every person with a sound nature to believe whoever came with the clear signs that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came with, without learning it from a human being, nor taking anything from a human being, as Ad-Dahhak said on the authority of Ibn Abbas, And We have sent down to you clear signs, meaning: So you recite it to them and inform them of it morning and evening and in between, and you are illiterate in their eyes, you have not read a book, and you inform them of what is in their hands in its face, God Almighty says in that a lesson and clarification, and upon them is an argument if they only knew. Muhammad bin Ishaq said: Muhammad bin Abi Muhammad told me on the authority of Ikrimah or Saeed bin Jubayr, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, he said: Ibn Suriya Al-Qatwini said to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace: O Muhammad, you have not brought us anything that we know, and God has not sent down to you a clear sign. And we follow you, so God revealed in that regard from His saying: And We have certainly sent down to you clear signs, and none disbelieve in them except the defiantly disobedient. Malik bin Al-Saif said when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent: And he reminded them of the covenant that was taken from them and what was entrusted to them regarding Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and by God, He did not entrust us regarding Muhammad, nor did He take a covenant from us, so God, the Most High, revealed: Or every time they make a covenant, a party of them casts it aside? Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: In His saying: But most of them do not believe, he said: Yes, there is no covenant on earth that they make except that they break it and cast it aside, they make a covenant today and break it tomorrow. Al-Suddi said: They do not believe in what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought. Qatada said: A party of them cast it aside, meaning a party of them broke it. Ibn Jarir said: The origin of Nabdh is throwing and casting, and from it the foundling is called Manbudh, and from it Nabidh is called, which is dates and raisins if they are thrown into water. Abu Al-Aswad Al-Du’ali said: I looked at its label and threw it away as you throw away a worn-out sandal. From your sandals I said: The people were blamed by God for their abandonment of the covenants that God had given them to adhere to and fulfill their rights, and for this reason He followed that with the denial of the Messenger sent to them and to all people, whose description, description and report are in their books, and in which they were commanded to follow him, support him and aid him, as God Almighty said: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel 10:13, and He said here: And when there came to them a Messenger from God confirming what was with them 10:13, meaning a group of them threw the Book of God that was in their hands, which contained the good report of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, behind their backs, meaning they abandoned it as if they did not know what was in it, and they turned to learning magic and following it, and for this reason they wanted to plot against the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they bewitched him with a comb, a tong and the dried skin of a male palm tree under a ra’ufah in the well of Arwan, and the one who took charge of that among them was a man called Labid bin Al-A’sam, may God curse him and make him ugly, so God informed His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, of that And he delivered him and cured him of it and saved him, as was proven in detail in the two Sahihs on the authority of Aisha, the Mother of the Believers, may God be pleased with her, as will be explained. Al-Suddi said, And when there came to them a Messenger from God confirming what was with them, he said: When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to them, they opposed him with the Torah, so they argued with him about it, and the Torah and the Qur’an agreed, so they rejected the Torah and took the book of Asif, and the magic of Harut and Marut, so it did not agree with the Qur’an. This is what He said, As if they did not know. Qatada said regarding His statement, As if they did not know, he said: The people knew, but they rejected their knowledge and concealed it and denied it. Al-Awfi said in his interpretation on the authority of Ibn Abbas regarding the statement of God Almighty, And they followed what the devils recited, the verse, and when the kingdom of Solomon was gone, groups of the jinn and humans apostatized and followed desires. When God restored Solomon’s kingdom to Solomon, and the people stood upon the religion as it was, and Solomon appeared upon their books, he buried them under his throne, and Solomon, peace be upon him, died, and that happened, so the humans and jinn appeared upon the books after the death of Solomon and they said: This is a book from God that was sent down to Solomon, but he hid it from us, so they took it and made it a religion, so God revealed: And when there came to them a messenger from God confirming what was with them (1:100) and they followed the desires that the devils recited, which are musical instruments and games and everything that distracts from the remembrance of God. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Saeed Al-Ashja told us, Abu Usamah told us on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Al-Minhal, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, he said: Asaf was Solomon’s scribe, and he knew the Greatest Name, and he used to write everything by Solomon’s command and bury it under his throne, so when Solomon died, the devils brought him out, and they wrote between every two lines magic and blasphemy, and they said: This is what Solomon used to do. He said: So the ignorant people disbelieved in him and cursed him, and the scholars of the people stopped, so the ignorant people continued to curse him until God revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved” (1:100) and Ibn Jarir said: Abu Al-Sa’ib Salim bin Junadah told me Al-Suwa’i narrated to us, Abu Mu’awiyah, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Al-Munhal, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: When Solomon, peace be upon him, wanted to go to the toilet or have intercourse with any of his wives, he would give his ring to the locust, which was a woman. When God wanted to test Solomon, peace be upon him, with what He tested him with, He gave the locust his ring one day. Then Satan came in the form of Solomon and said: Give me my ring. So he took it and wore it. When he wore it, the devils, jinn, and humans obeyed him. He said: So Solomon came to her and said to her: Give me my ring. She said: You lied, you are not Solomon. He said: So Solomon realized that it was a trial with which he was tested. He said: So the devils went out and wrote books in those days that contained magic and blasphemy. They buried them under Solomon’s throne, then they took them out and read them to the people and said: Solomon used to overcome the people with these books. He said: So the people disavowed Solomon and disbelieved in him until God sent Muhammad, peace be upon him, and revealed to him: It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved. Then Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, on the authority of Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Imran, who is the son of al-Harith, who said: While we were with Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, a man came and said to him: Where did you come from? He said: From Iraq. He said: From which country? He said: From Kufa. He said: What is the report? He said: I left them talking that Ali is coming to them, so he was frightened, then he said: What are you saying, may your father be cursed? If we knew, we would not have married his women or divided his inheritance. As for me, I will tell you about that. The devils used to eavesdrop from the sky, and one of them would come with a word of truth that he had heard. If he was tested and believed it, he would lie with it seventy lies. He said: So the hearts of the people would absorb it. He said: So God informed Solomon, peace be upon him, of it, so he buried it under his throne. When Solomon, peace be upon him, died, the devil of the road stood up and said: Shall I guide you to his forbidden treasure, the like of which is unmatched? Under the throne. So they took him out, and he said: This is magic. The nations copied it until the remnants of it were what the people of Iraq were talking about. Then God, the Almighty, revealed: “And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” The verse. Al-Hakim narrated in his Mustadrak on the authority of Abu Zakariya al-Anbari, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Salam, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Jarir, on his authority. Al-Suddi said about the words of God Almighty: And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon, meaning during the reign of Solomon. He said: The devils would ascend to the heavens and sit in places to listen, and they would listen to the words of the angels about what would happen on earth of death, the unseen, or any matter. They would go to the priests and inform them, and the priests would tell the people and they would find it as they said. When the priests trusted them, they lied to them and inserted something else into it, adding seventy words to each word. The people wrote down that hadith in books, and it spread among the Children of Israel that the jinn knew the unseen. So Solomon sent among the people, and he collected those books and put them in a chest, then buried them under his throne. No devil could come near the throne without being burned. He said: I do not hear anyone mentioning that the devils know the unseen without being struck. When Solomon died, and the scholars who knew about Solomon were gone, and after that there was a successor, Satan appeared in the form of a human being and then came to a group of the Children of Israel and said to them: Shall I guide you to a treasure that you will never eat? They said: Yes. He said: Dig under the throne. So he went with them and showed them the place and stood near it. They said to him: Come closer. He said: No, but I am here in your hands. If you do not find it, kill me. So they dug and found those books. When they took them out, Satan said: Solomon only controlled humans, devils and birds with this magic. Then he flew away and spread among the people that Solomon was a magician. The Children of Israel took those books. When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came, they argued with him about them. That is when God Almighty says: It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved. Al-Rabi’ bin Anas said: The Jews asked Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, about matters from the Torah for a time, and they would not ask him about anything except that God Almighty revealed what they asked him about, so he argued with them. When they saw that They said: He knows better than we do what God has revealed to us. They asked him about magic and argued with him about it, so God the Almighty revealed: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic.” The devils took a book and wrote in it magic and divination and whatever God willed of that, and buried it under the seat of Solomon’s council. He, peace be upon him, did not know the unseen. When Solomon left this world, they extracted that magic and deceived the people and said: This is knowledge that Solomon concealed and envied the people for. The Prophet, peace be upon him, informed them of this hadith, so they returned from him and God had refuted their argument. Mujahid said about the Almighty’s statement: And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon, that the devils listened to the revelation, but whenever they heard a word they added two hundred like it. So Solomon, peace be upon him, sent for what they had written of that, and when Solomon died, the devils found it and taught it to the people, which was magic. Saeed bin Jubair said: Solomon used to track down what magic was in the hands of the devils and take it from them and bury it under his seat in his treasury house, but the devils could not. To reach him, so he approached the people and they said to them, Do you know what knowledge Solomon used to subjugate the devils, winds, and other things? They said: Yes. They said: It is in his treasury and under his chair. He consulted people about it and they extracted it and worked with it. The people of Hijaz said: Solomon knew about this and this is magic. So God Almighty revealed to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, the innocence of Solomon, peace be upon him, and God Almighty said: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar said: When the devils learned of the death of Solomon, son of David, peace be upon him, the devils deliberately wrote down the types of magic. Whoever wants to achieve such-and-such should do such-and-such. When they classified the types of magic, they put it in a book and sealed it with a seal engraved with the seal of Solomon and wrote on its title: This is what Asaf bin Barkhiya the Truthful wrote to King Solomon, son of David, from the treasures of the treasures of knowledge. Then they buried it under his chair and the remnants of the Children of Israel extracted it after that until they innovated what they innovated. When they found it, they said: By God, Solomon’s reign was only this. So they spread magic among the people and they learned it and taught it. There is no one who has it more than the Jews, may God curse them. So when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned in what was revealed to him: From God, Solomon, son of David, and He promised him among those He counted among the messengers. The Jews in Medina said: Do you not marvel at Muhammad, who claims that the son of David was a prophet, when by God he was nothing but a magician? And God revealed in that regard their saying: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” The verse. Ibn Jarir said: Al-Qasim told us: Hussain told us: Al-Hajjaj told us, on the authority of Abu Bakr, on the authority of Shahr bin Hawshab, who said: When Solomon’s kingdom was taken away, the devils used to write down magic during Solomon’s absence. They wrote: Whoever wants to do such and such should face the sun and say such and such, and whoever wants to do such and such should turn his back to the sun and say such and such. So they wrote it down and made its title: This is what Asaf bin Barkhiya wrote to King Solomon, son of David, peace be upon them, from the treasures of the treasures of knowledge. Then he buried it under his throne. When Solomon, peace be upon him, died, Satan, may God curse him, stood up and gave a sermon and said: O people, Solomon was not a prophet, but a magician, so seek out his magic in his belongings and houses. Then He showed them the place where he was buried, and they said: By God, Solomon was a magician, this is his magic, this is how we worship him and this is how we are subdued. The believers said: Rather, he was a believing prophet. When God sent the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and mentioned David and Solomon, the Jews said: Look at Muhammad mixing truth with falsehood, mentioning Solomon with the prophets, he was only a magician who rode the wind. Then God Almighty revealed: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. And Solomon did not disbelieve.” Ibn Jarir said: Muhammad bin Abdul A’la al-San’ani told us, al-Mu’tamir bin Sulayman told us, he said: I heard Imran bin Hudayr from Abu Majlaz who said: Solomon, peace be upon him, took a covenant from every animal, and if a man was afflicted and asked about that covenant, he was released. So the people increased the rhyme and magic, and they said: This is what Solomon, son of David, peace be upon them, did. Then God Almighty said: And Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Issam bin Rawad told us, Adam told us, al-Mas’udi told us, on the authority of Ziyad, the client of Ibn Mus’ab, on the authority of al-Hasan, “And they followed What the devils recite" He said: A third of poetry, a third of magic, and a third of divination. He said: Al-Hasan bin Ahmad told us, Ibrahim bin Abdullah bin Bashar Al-Wasiti told us, Surur bin Al-Mughira told me, on the authority of Ibad bin Mansour, on the authority of Al-Hasan: "And they followed what the devils recite during the reign of Solomon" and the Jews followed it during his reign, and magic was on earth before that and had not ceased to exist in it, but it was only followed during the reign of Solomon. This is a summary of the sayings of the Imams of the Salaf in this regard, and the summary of the story and the combination of its parts and that there is no contradiction between the contexts is not hidden from the intelligent and understanding, and God is the guide. And the Almighty said: "And they followed what the devils recite during the reign of Solomon" meaning and the Jews who were given the Book followed after their turning away from the Book of God that was in their hands, and their opposition to the Messenger of God Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, what the devils recite, meaning what the devils narrate and tell and speak during the reign of Solomon, and he made it transitive with "ala because it included recite and lie". Ibn Jarir said "ala here means in", meaning they recite during the reign of Solomon, and he transmitted it from Ibn Jurayj and Ibn Isaac I said and the inclusion is better and more appropriate, and God knows best. And the saying of Al-Hasan Al-Basri, may God have mercy on him, and the magic was before the time of Solomon, son of David - is correct without a doubt, because the magicians were in the time of Moses, peace be upon him, and Solomon, son of David, after him, as God Almighty said, “Have you not seen the assembly of the Children of Israel after Moses?” The verse, then he mentioned the story after it and in it, And David killed Goliath, and God gave him the kingdom and wisdom. And the people of Salih, who were before Abraham, peace be upon him, said to their prophet Salih, You are only one of those bewitched, meaning those bewitched according to the well-known, and God Almighty said, And what was revealed to the two angels in Babylon, Harut and Marut, and they did not teach anyone until they had said, “We are only a trial, so do not disbelieve, and they learned from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife.” People differed in this regard, so some of them went to the fact that what is negative, I mean that which is in His statement, and what was revealed to the two angels, Al-Qurtubi said: what is negative and is connected to His statement, “and Solomon did not disbelieve, then he said, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and what was revealed to the two angels, and that is because the Jews were claiming That Gabriel and Michael came down with it, so God denied them and made His saying Harut and Marut instead of the devils. He said: This is correct either because the plural is used for the two as in the Almighty’s saying: If he has brothers, or because they have followers or are mentioned among them for their rebellion, the meaning of the speech is that they teach people magic in Babylon, Harut and Marut. Then he said: This is the most appropriate and correct way to interpret the verse and no attention should be paid to anything else. Ibn Jarir narrated with his chain of transmission on the authority of Al-Awfi on the authority of Ibn Abbas in his saying and what was revealed to the two angels in Babylon the verse, he says God did not reveal magic. And with his chain of transmission on the authority of Al-Rabi’ bin Anas in his saying and what was revealed to the two angels he said: God did not reveal magic to them. Ibn Jarir said: So the interpretation of the verse according to this is and they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon of magic, and Solomon did not disbelieve nor did God reveal magic to the two angels, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic in Babylon, Harut and Marut, so His saying in Babylon, Harut and Marut is from the delayed meaning of the advanced. He said: If someone were to say to us: How did this come to mind? It was said that the reason for presenting it is to say, And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon, of magic, and Solomon did not disbelieve, and God did not send down magic to the two angels, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic in Babylon, Harut and Marut, so it is meant by the two angels Gabriel and Michael, peace be upon them, because the Jewish magicians, as I mentioned, claimed that God sent down magic through the tongues of Gabriel and Michael to Solomon, son of David, so God denied them in that. He informed His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, that Gabriel and Michael did not send down magic, and he acquitted Solomon, peace be upon him, of what they attributed to them of magic, and he informed them that magic is the work of the devils and that they teach it to people in Babylon, and that those who teach them that are two men: one of them is named Harut, and the other is named Marut, so Harut and Marut, according to this interpretation, are a translation from the people and a response to them. This is its wording verbatim, and Ibn Abi Hatim said: I was told by Ubaydullah bin Musa, Fadil bin Marzuq told us, on the authority of Atiyah, And what was sent down to the two angels, he said: God did not send down magic to Gabriel and Michael, he said: Ibn Abi Hatim: Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan informed us, Muhammad ibn Isa informed us, Ya`la, meaning Ibn Asad informed us, Bakr, meaning Ibn Mus`ab informed us, Al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja`far informed us: that `Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza used to recite it: And what was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. Abu al-`Aliyah said: Magic was not revealed to them, meaning: knowledge of faith and disbelief, so magic is from disbelief, so they forbid it most strongly. Narrated by Ibn Abi Hatim. Then Ibn Jarir began to refute this statement, and that what means which, and he spoke at length about that and claimed that Harut and Marut were two angels whom God sent down to earth and permitted them to teach magic as a test and examination for His servants after He made clear to His servants that it is something that is forbidden on the tongues of the Messengers. He claimed that Harut and Marut were obedient in teaching that, because they complied with what they were commanded to do. This is something that he followed, and stranger than that is the statement of those who claimed that Harut and Marut were two tribes of the jinn, as Ibn Hazm claimed. Ibn Abi Hatim narrated: On the authority of Ad-Dahhak bin Muzahim that he used to read it and what was sent down to the two angels and he said: They are two giants from the people of Babylon. The proponents of this opinion explained that sending down means creation, not inspiration, as in the words of God Almighty: and what was sent down to the two angels as God Almighty said: And He sent down for you eight pairs of livestock “and We sent down iron, wherein is great strength” and He sends down for you provision from the sky and in the hadith: God has not sent down a disease except that He has sent down a cure for it and as it is said: God sent down good and evil. Al-Qurtubi narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas, Ibn Abza and Al-Hasan Al-Basri that they read and what was sent down to the two angels with a kasra on the lam. Ibn Abza said: They are David and Solomon. Al-Qurtubi said: According to this, what is also a negative. Others stopped at his words they teach people magic and what is a negative. Ibn Jarir said: Yunus told me, Ibn Wahb told us, Al-Layth told us on the authority of Yahya bin Saeed on the authority of Al-Qasim bin Muhammad and a man asked him about the words of God Almighty: they teach people magic and what was sent down to the two angels In Babylon, Harut and Marut.” He said: The two men teach people what was revealed to them and teach people what was not revealed to them. Al-Qasim said: I do not care which of them it was. Then he narrated on the authority of Yunus on the authority of Anas bin Ayyad on the authority of some of his companions that Al-Qasim said in this story: I do not care which of them it was, I believed in it. Many of the predecessors believed that they were two angels from heaven, and that they were sent down to earth, and what happened to them happened. A hadith was narrated on this subject by Imam Ahmad in his Musnad, may God have mercy on him, as we will mention, God willing. Based on this, the combination between this and what was reported of the evidence for the infallibility of the angels is that God had previously known about these two, so it is a specification for them, so there is no contradiction then, as was previously mentioned in His knowledge of the matter of Iblis, and in His statement that he was one of the angels, based on the Almighty’s statement: And when We said to the angels, ‘Prostrate to Adam,’ and they prostrated, except for Iblis, he refused. And other verses indicating this, even though the matter of Harut and Marut is as mentioned. Less severe than what happened from Satan, may God curse him. Al-Qurtubi narrated it on the authority of Ali, Ibn Masoud, Ibn Abbas, Ibn Omar, Kaab al-Ahbar, al-Suddi, and al-Kalbi.
2:100: Indeed, We have sent down to you clear verses, and none disbelieve in them except the defiantly disobedient. * Or whenever they make a covenant, a party of them casts it aside? Rather, most of them do not believe. * And when there came to them a messenger from God confirming what was with them, a party of those who were given the Scripture cast the Scripture of God behind their backs as if they did not know. * And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. And Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and what was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. Imam Abu Ja`far ibn Jarir said about the words of God the Almighty: And We have sent down to you clear verses the verse, meaning, We have sent down to you, O Muhammad, clear signs, indicating your prophethood, and those verses are what the Book of God contains of the hidden knowledge of the Jews, and the hidden secrets of their report and the report of their forefathers from the Children of Israel, and the report of what their books contained that only their rabbis and scholars knew, and what their forefathers and later ones distorted and changed of their rulings that It was in the Torah, so God revealed in His Book that He sent down to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and in that were clear signs for those who were fair to themselves and did not let envy and oppression lead to their destruction, since it was in the nature of every person with a sound nature to believe whoever came with the clear signs that Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came with, without learning it from a human being, nor taking anything from a human being, as Ad-Dahhak said on the authority of Ibn Abbas, And We have sent down to you clear signs, meaning: So you recite it to them and inform them of it morning and evening and in between, and you are illiterate in their eyes, you have not read a book, and you inform them of what is in their hands in its face, God Almighty says in that a lesson and clarification, and upon them is an argument if they only knew. Muhammad bin Ishaq said: Muhammad bin Abi Muhammad told me on the authority of Ikrimah or Saeed bin Jubayr, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, he said: Ibn Suriya Al-Qatwini said to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace: O Muhammad, you have not brought us anything that we know, and God has not sent down to you a clear sign. And we follow you, so God revealed in that regard from His saying: And We have certainly sent down to you clear signs, and none disbelieve in them except the defiantly disobedient. Malik bin Al-Saif said when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, was sent: And he reminded them of the covenant that was taken from them and what was entrusted to them regarding Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and by God, He did not entrust us regarding Muhammad, nor did He take a covenant from us, so God, the Most High, revealed: Or every time they make a covenant, a party of them casts it aside? Al-Hasan Al-Basri said: In His saying: But most of them do not believe, he said: Yes, there is no covenant on earth that they make except that they break it and cast it aside, they make a covenant today and break it tomorrow. Al-Suddi said: They do not believe in what Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, brought. Qatada said: A party of them cast it aside, meaning a party of them broke it. Ibn Jarir said: The origin of Nabdh is throwing and casting, and from it the foundling is called Manbudh, and from it Nabidh is called, which is dates and raisins if they are thrown into water. Abu Al-Aswad Al-Du’ali said: I looked at its label and threw it away as you throw away a worn-out sandal. From your sandals I said: The people were blamed by God for their abandonment of the covenants that God had given them to adhere to and fulfill their rights, and for this reason He followed that with the denial of the Messenger sent to them and to all people, whose description, description and report are in their books, and in which they were commanded to follow him, support him and aid him, as God Almighty said: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered Prophet, whom they find written in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel 10:13, and He said here: And when there came to them a Messenger from God confirming what was with them 10:13, meaning a group of them threw the Book of God that was in their hands, which contained the good report of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, behind their backs, meaning they abandoned it as if they did not know what was in it, and they turned to learning magic and following it, and for this reason they wanted to plot against the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and they bewitched him with a comb, a tong and the dried skin of a male palm tree under a ra’ufah in the well of Arwan, and the one who took charge of that among them was a man called Labid bin Al-A’sam, may God curse him and make him ugly, so God informed His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, of that And he delivered him and cured him of it and saved him, as was proven in detail in the two Sahihs on the authority of Aisha, the Mother of the Believers, may God be pleased with her, as will be explained. Al-Suddi said, And when there came to them a Messenger from God confirming what was with them, he said: When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came to them, they opposed him with the Torah, so they argued with him about it, and the Torah and the Qur’an agreed, so they rejected the Torah and took the book of Asif, and the magic of Harut and Marut, so it did not agree with the Qur’an. This is what He said, As if they did not know. Qatada said regarding His statement, As if they did not know, he said: The people knew, but they rejected their knowledge and concealed it and denied it. Al-Awfi said in his interpretation on the authority of Ibn Abbas regarding the statement of God Almighty, And they followed what the devils recited, the verse, and when the kingdom of Solomon was gone, groups of the jinn and humans apostatized and followed desires. When God restored Solomon’s kingdom to Solomon, and the people stood upon the religion as it was, and Solomon appeared upon their books, he buried them under his throne, and Solomon, peace be upon him, died, and that happened, so the humans and jinn appeared upon the books after the death of Solomon and they said: This is a book from God that was sent down to Solomon, but he hid it from us, so they took it and made it a religion, so God revealed: And when there came to them a messenger from God confirming what was with them (1:100) and they followed the desires that the devils recited, which are musical instruments and games and everything that distracts from the remembrance of God. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Saeed Al-Ashja told us, Abu Usamah told us on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Al-Minhal, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, he said: Asaf was Solomon’s scribe, and he knew the Greatest Name, and he used to write everything by Solomon’s command and bury it under his throne, so when Solomon died, the devils brought him out, and they wrote between every two lines magic and blasphemy, and they said: This is what Solomon used to do. He said: So the ignorant people disbelieved in him and cursed him, and the scholars of the people stopped, so the ignorant people continued to curse him until God revealed to Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved” (1:100) and Ibn Jarir said: Abu Al-Sa’ib Salim bin Junadah told me Al-Suwa’i narrated to us, Abu Mu’awiyah, on the authority of Al-A’mash, on the authority of Al-Munhal, on the authority of Saeed bin Jubair, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: When Solomon, peace be upon him, wanted to go to the toilet or have intercourse with any of his wives, he would give his ring to the locust, which was a woman. When God wanted to test Solomon, peace be upon him, with what He tested him with, He gave the locust his ring one day. Then Satan came in the form of Solomon and said: Give me my ring. So he took it and wore it. When he wore it, the devils, jinn, and humans obeyed him. He said: So Solomon came to her and said to her: Give me my ring. She said: You lied, you are not Solomon. He said: So Solomon realized that it was a trial with which he was tested. He said: So the devils went out and wrote books in those days that contained magic and blasphemy. They buried them under Solomon’s throne, then they took them out and read them to the people and said: Solomon used to overcome the people with these books. He said: So the people disavowed Solomon and disbelieved in him until God sent Muhammad, peace be upon him, and revealed to him: It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved. Then Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, on the authority of Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Imran, who is the son of al-Harith, who said: While we were with Ibn Abbas, may God be pleased with them both, a man came and said to him: Where did you come from? He said: From Iraq. He said: From which country? He said: From Kufa. He said: What is the report? He said: I left them talking that Ali is coming to them, so he was frightened, then he said: What are you saying, may your father be cursed? If we knew, we would not have married his women or divided his inheritance. As for me, I will tell you about that. The devils used to eavesdrop from the sky, and one of them would come with a word of truth that he had heard. If he was tested and believed it, he would lie with it seventy lies. He said: So the hearts of the people would absorb it. He said: So God informed Solomon, peace be upon him, of it, so he buried it under his throne. When Solomon, peace be upon him, died, the devil of the road stood up and said: Shall I guide you to his forbidden treasure, the like of which is unmatched? Under the throne. So they took him out, and he said: This is magic. The nations copied it until the remnants of it were what the people of Iraq were talking about. Then God, the Almighty, revealed: “And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” The verse. Al-Hakim narrated in his Mustadrak on the authority of Abu Zakariya al-Anbari, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abd al-Salam, on the authority of Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, on the authority of Jarir, on his authority. Al-Suddi said about the words of God Almighty: And they followed what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon, meaning during the reign of Solomon. He said: The devils would ascend to the heavens and sit in places to listen, and they would listen to the words of the angels about what would happen on earth of death, the unseen, or any matter. They would go to the priests and inform them, and the priests would tell the people and they would find it as they said. When the priests trusted them, they lied to them and inserted something else into it, adding seventy words to each word. The people wrote down that hadith in books, and it spread among the Children of Israel that the jinn knew the unseen. So Solomon sent among the people, and he collected those books and put them in a chest, then buried them under his throne. No devil could come near the throne without being burned. He said: I do not hear anyone mentioning that the devils know the unseen without being struck. When Solomon died, and the scholars who knew about Solomon were gone, and after that there was a successor, Satan appeared in the form of a human being and then came to a group of the Children of Israel and said to them: Shall I guide you to a treasure that you will never eat? They said: Yes. He said: Dig under the throne. So he went with them and showed them the place and stood near it. They said to him: Come closer. He said: No, but I am here in your hands. If you do not find it, kill me. So they dug and found those books. When they took them out, Satan said: Solomon only controlled humans, devils and birds with this magic. Then he flew away and spread among the people that Solomon was a magician. The Children of Israel took those books. When Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, came, they argued with him about them. That is when God Almighty says: It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved. Al-Rabi’ bin Anas said: The Jews asked Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, about matters from the Torah for a time, and they would not ask him about anything except that God Almighty revealed what they asked him about, so he argued with them. When they saw that They said: He knows better than we do what God has revealed to us. They asked him about magic and argued with him about it, so God the Almighty revealed: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic.” The devils took a book and wrote in it magic and divination and whatever God willed of that, and buried it under the seat of Solomon’s council. He, peace be upon him, did not know the unseen. When Solomon left this world, they extracted that magic and deceived the people and said: This is knowledge that Solomon concealed and envied the people for. The Prophet, peace be upon him, informed them of this hadith, so they returned from him and God had refuted their argument. Mujahid said about the Almighty’s statement: And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon, that the devils listened to the revelation, but whenever they heard a word they added two hundred like it. So Solomon, peace be upon him, sent for what they had written of that, and when Solomon died, the devils found it and taught it to the people, which was magic. Saeed bin Jubair said: Solomon used to track down what magic was in the hands of the devils and take it from them and bury it under his seat in his treasury house, but the devils could not. To reach him, so he approached the people and they said to them, Do you know what knowledge Solomon used to subjugate the devils, winds, and other things? They said: Yes. They said: It is in his treasury and under his chair. He consulted people about it and they extracted it and worked with it. The people of Hijaz said: Solomon knew about this and this is magic. So God Almighty revealed to His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, the innocence of Solomon, peace be upon him, and God Almighty said: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” Muhammad bin Ishaq bin Yasar said: When the devils learned of the death of Solomon, son of David, peace be upon him, the devils deliberately wrote down the types of magic. Whoever wants to achieve such-and-such should do such-and-such. When they classified the types of magic, they put it in a book and sealed it with a seal engraved with the seal of Solomon and wrote on its title: This is what Asaf bin Barkhiya the Truthful wrote to King Solomon, son of David, from the treasures of the treasures of knowledge. Then they buried it under his chair and the remnants of the Children of Israel extracted it after that until they innovated what they innovated. When they found it, they said: By God, Solomon’s reign was only this. So they spread magic among the people and they learned it and taught it. There is no one who has it more than the Jews, may God curse them. So when the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, mentioned in what was revealed to him: From God, Solomon, son of David, and He promised him among those He counted among the messengers. The Jews in Medina said: Do you not marvel at Muhammad, who claims that the son of David was a prophet, when by God he was nothing but a magician? And God revealed in that regard their saying: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved.” The verse. Ibn Jarir said: Al-Qasim told us: Hussain told us: Al-Hajjaj told us, on the authority of Abu Bakr, on the authority of Shahr bin Hawshab, who said: When Solomon’s kingdom was taken away, the devils used to write down magic during Solomon’s absence. They wrote: Whoever wants to do such and such should face the sun and say such and such, and whoever wants to do such and such should turn his back to the sun and say such and such. So they wrote it down and made its title: This is what Asaf bin Barkhiya wrote to King Solomon, son of David, peace be upon them, from the treasures of the treasures of knowledge. Then he buried it under his throne. When Solomon, peace be upon him, died, Satan, may God curse him, stood up and gave a sermon and said: O people, Solomon was not a prophet, but a magician, so seek out his magic in his belongings and houses. Then He showed them the place where he was buried, and they said: By God, Solomon was a magician, this is his magic, this is how we worship him and this is how we are subdued. The believers said: Rather, he was a believing prophet. When God sent the Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, and mentioned David and Solomon, the Jews said: Look at Muhammad mixing truth with falsehood, mentioning Solomon with the prophets, he was only a magician who rode the wind. Then God Almighty revealed: “And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon. And Solomon did not disbelieve.” Ibn Jarir said: Muhammad bin Abdul A’la al-San’ani told us, al-Mu’tamir bin Sulayman told us, he said: I heard Imran bin Hudayr from Abu Majlaz who said: Solomon, peace be upon him, took a covenant from every animal, and if a man was afflicted and asked about that covenant, he was released. So the people increased the rhyme and magic, and they said: This is what Solomon, son of David, peace be upon them, did. Then God Almighty said: And Solomon did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Issam bin Rawad told us, Adam told us, al-Mas’udi told us, on the authority of Ziyad, the client of Ibn Mus’ab, on the authority of al-Hasan, “And they followed What the devils recite" He said: A third of poetry, a third of magic, and a third of divination. He said: Al-Hasan bin Ahmad told us, Ibrahim bin Abdullah bin Bashar Al-Wasiti told us, Surur bin Al-Mughira told me, on the authority of Ibad bin Mansour, on the authority of Al-Hasan: "And they followed what the devils recite during the reign of Solomon" and the Jews followed it during his reign, and magic was on earth before that and had not ceased to exist in it, but it was only followed during the reign of Solomon. It was said that the reason for presenting it is to say, And they followed what the devils recited during the reign of Solomon, of magic, and Solomon did not disbelieve, and God did not send down magic to the two angels, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic in Babylon, Harut and Marut, so it is meant by the two angels Gabriel and Michael, peace be upon them, because the Jewish magicians, as I mentioned, claimed that God sent down magic through the tongues of Gabriel and Michael to Solomon, son of David, so God denied them in that. He informed His Prophet Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, that Gabriel and Michael did not send down magic, and he acquitted Solomon, peace be upon him, of what they attributed to them of magic, and he informed them that magic is the work of the devils and that they teach it to people in Babylon, and that those who teach them that are two men: one of them is named Harut, and the other is named Marut, so Harut and Marut, according to this interpretation, are a translation from the people and a response to them. This is its wording verbatim, and Ibn Abi Hatim said: I was told by Ubaydullah bin Musa, Fadil bin Marzuq told us, on the authority of Atiyah, And what was sent down to the two angels, he said: God did not send down magic to Gabriel and Michael, he said: Ibn Abi Hatim: Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan informed us, Muhammad ibn Isa informed us, Ya`la, meaning Ibn Asad informed us, Bakr, meaning Ibn Mus`ab informed us, Al-Hasan ibn Abi Ja`far informed us: that `Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza used to recite it: And what was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. Abu al-`Aliyah said: Magic was not revealed to them, meaning: knowledge of faith and disbelief, so magic is from disbelief, so they forbid it most strongly. Narrated by Ibn Abi Hatim. Then Ibn Jarir began to refute this statement, and that what means which, and he spoke at length about that and claimed that Harut and Marut were two angels whom God sent down to earth and permitted them to teach magic as a test and examination for His servants after He made clear to His servants that it is something that is forbidden on the tongues of the Messengers. He claimed that Harut and Marut were obedient in teaching that, because they complied with what they were commanded to do. This is something that he followed, and stranger than that is the statement of those who claimed that Harut and Marut were two tribes of the jinn, as Ibn Hazm claimed.
